final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry and checking if its level is ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required format, extracted the service, level (upper case), message, and the last line of any traceback as the exception (or null if none). I also handled repeated messages by summing the repeat counts from the following lines. Finally, I counted the total errors per service and wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the required JSON structure.
